name: contribution-gateway
description: Policy-as-config gate for pull requests: linked issues, newcomer PR limits, checklists and disclosure, with no AI guessing.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --metafile=build-meta.json --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node scripts/licenses.mjs build-meta.json
